name: Adiel
overview: Adiel is a male figure from the tribe of Simeon, mentioned briefly in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles. His unique attribute is uncertain, as the text in 1 Chronicles 4:36 provides minimal detail beyond his identification as a Simeonite. There are no additional notes or significant narrative elements associated with him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Adiel means 'adornment of God [El],' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew name that honors God. This proper name is listed in 1 Chronicles 4:36 and is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Adiel is explicitly identified as a descendant of Simeon, situating him within the lineage of one of Israel's twelve tribes. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this tribal affiliation.
scriptureSignificance: Adiel's significance lies primarily in his inclusion within the genealogical records of the tribe of Simeon, contributing to the biblical record of Israel's tribal heritage. While little is detailed about his life or deeds, his mention preserves the continuity of God's chosen people and their tribal identities. This underscores the importance Scripture places on lineage and the fulfillment of God's promises through the tribes of Israel.
